display.description: Sunken Ledger quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Sunken Ledger

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
Sunken Ledger is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: A compass from the wreck and pages to save the route. Good. The water can keep the rest.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: I still need 8 paper to copy the ledger cleanly.
missing_proof: Bring me a compass from the wreck. Direction is the point of this errand.
missing_target: The compass matters after you reach the wreck itself.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then the tide keeps the minutes. It is very possessive.
A wreck offshore may hold old route notes. Most wet paper lies. A compass lies less.
There is a shipwreck I want checked before its records become pulp.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Shipwreck near {target_x}, {target_z}. Compass for proof, paper for the ledger.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

locate_failed: The coast is not answering. I cannot find a wreck worth sending you to.
started: The wreck should be {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a compass and 8 paper for the copy.
unavailable: Not every villager should trust you with drowned records yet.

lines: Did the wreck give up a route, or only damp pockets?
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
